decisions.reason: The archiving and reporting software has its own web page, is central to the firm's announced web-based, data-driven direction, and carries sunk development investment, so management will persist with it.
Although it overlaps with A and has less visible commitment, it fits the digital strategy, and management would sooner merge it into the archiving line than openly withdraw it.
The manhole door with safety railing extends the established hardware line, has its own web page, and serves steady municipal safety demand, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
